11th Circ. Says Epstein Victim's Rights Weren't Squashed
A divided Eleventh Circuit panel on Tuesday denied a petition from a victim of
Jeffrey Epstein challenging a nonprosecution deal reached with the billionaire
sex offender, saying her rights as a victim were not violated by the deal
because federal prosecutors never actually brought charges against Epstein.
